Tom has started playing [[Quake]] on LAN in [[2000]] with 3 friends: [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Hubo]], [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[NICK]] and [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Toniu]]. After not long time he discovered [[Omicron Bot]] and played versus it most of the time. In [[2001]] he moved to [[QuakeWorld]] playing [[Frogbot]] and [[Frogbot Clan Arena]] mod. At the same time he met [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Goniec]] and played with him a lot on the LAN.
Finally, in [[2004]], he got internet connection and started playing [[QuakeWorld]] online. Founder and organizer of QW LAN PL parties in Radomsko, Poland since 2020.
